title: Normal derivative integrated over a half-space equals minus the boundary integral
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, let ι : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m+1} be a linear isometry and v ∈ ℝ^{m+1} with |v| = 1 and ⟨ι x, v⟩ = 0 for all x, and let h : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ be C¹ with compact support. Then ∫_{⟨w,v⟩>0} Dh(w)(v) dL^{m+1}(w) = −∫_{ℝ^m} h(ι x) dL^m(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) (v : Euclid (m + 1)) (h : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ x, inner ℝ (ι x) v = 0) → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → ∫ w in {w : Euclid (m + 1) | 0 < inner ℝ w v}, fderiv ℝ h w v = -∫ x, h (ι x)
